triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: Mitya had fallen ill with nervous fever, and was sent to the prison division of the town hospital.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: Doctor Varvinsky had put Mitya not with other prisoners, but in a separate little room, the one where Smerdyakov had been.

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: He had become terribly preoccupied since the trial; sometimes he would be silent for half an hour together

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: He looked sometimes with a face of suffering at his brother.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: It’s hard for her, you know,” Alyosha looked timidly at his brother.

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: “Alyosha, I love Grusha terribly,” he said suddenly in a shaking voice, full of tears.

triples.subject: Katya
triples.quote: She understands now, I think, that Katya no longer cares for me, but loves Ivan.

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: Rakitin had tried to force his way in twice, but Mitya persistently begged Varvinsky not to admit him.

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: He is seeking treasure all the time—the fifteen hundred roubles which the prosecutor said I’d hidden there.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: “Alyosha, run after her!” Mitya cried to his brother; “tell her ... I don’t know ... don’t let her go away like this!”

triples.subject: Katya
triples.quote: to tell you again that you are my god, my joy, to tell you that I love you madly

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: do you know, five days ago, that same evening, I loved you.... When you fell down and were carried out

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: “We are full of hatred, my girl, you and I! We are both full of hatred! As though we could forgive one another!
